limitations: Only single API input entities are sampled, including one whole-sheet-body input.
Tangent chaining and Rounded/Sharp controls are verified; their effects on more complex face networks remain untested.
Face/body descriptors expose explicit native historical body IDs; persistent face recipes do not yet resolve exact ASM faces.
Source/output native body identities do not by themselves prove final visibility or current body lifecycle.
Boolean participant body roles are outside this decoder.
Symmetric API input normalization is unresolved; parameter values are retained without converting them to side offsets.
Thickened geometry and native files are not regenerated.
